articles.summary: Every in-app agent is guessing from documentation someone wrote after the fact. Today we're launching the Frigade Assist API, so the agent you already built can learn your product the way a user does.
articles.title: Your product can't explain itself

articles.summary: The Frigade Assistant has always been an embed. You dropped it into your product and it became the thing your users talked to. If your team already built its own agent, that means two agents on screen
articles.title: Introducing the Assist API: product expertise for the agent you already built
